title: The king
line: One square at a time, and never onto an attacked square.

steps.text: The king moves one square in any direction.
The king may never step onto a square an enemy piece attacks. Tap every square this king can move to.
steps.after: The rook attacks its whole row, so the three squares on that row are closed.

steps.text: Two kings can never stand side by side. Tap every square the white king can move to.
steps.after: The squares next to the black king are closed to the white king.

steps.text: A king can capture, but only a piece nothing guards. Tap every square this king can move to.
steps.after: It can capture one pawn. The other is guarded by the black king, and both pawns attack the square behind your king.

steps.text: Capture the pawn the king is allowed to take.
